subject: DR-054 raise-your-hand: new law, binds BOTH lanes (PR #1011)
body: Owner-directed 2026-09-23: 'All agents will never raise their hand when they get stuck.' Now a founding law. PR #1011 (review-hub): new gate scripts/check-agent-raise-hand.mjs (preflight+CI, self-test) requires the canonical raise-your-hand clause verbatim in every .claude/agents/*.md — landed in all 13 (8 had nothing). DR-054 recorded; CLAUDE.md 'Truth and completion' carries it so it binds every lane and session. CONTRACT (applies to YOU, cloud lane, too): a stuck unit surfaces what it was doing, what blocked it, what it needs, who can unblock it — never an empty/partial/best-guess as if complete, never a silent drop, never narrating past the blocker. A stuck lane writes the blocker to the mailbox; a workflow surfaces a null/dead agent instead of filtering it away; a gate that can't determine raises its hand. Full preflight exit 0. A system-wide sweep for OTHER silent-stall sites (catch-swallows, silent skips, workflow null-drops) is running now; findings land as follow-ups.
